note: Beat sheet: 18 of the 15-20 target lines. Moods: amused, annoyed, triumphant, menacing. Max 15 words each.

lines.text: Mm, there it goes. Doesn't it feel nice to let something go?
Oh, that was fun. Burn another, Keeper. I'll carry it anywhere.
Delivered! Don't thank me. Nobody ever does.
Back and forth, hour to hour. I never get tired. Isn't that useful?
Another hour kept. You're so good at keeping things, Keeper.
Rewinding again? Fine. I'll wait. I'm very good at waiting.
Don't mind me, Keeper. I've got nothing but time. Hours and hours of it.
Still thinking? Some of us have been burning all day.
Oh, look. Company. They remember you, Keeper.
Another one. Every burn leaves something behind, Keeper. Didn't you know?
Ha! ...Ha. Funny. It used to echo further than that.
Go on, burn it. Somebody has to keep this place warm.
Gone? Oh, they don't go. They just wait somewhere you can't see.
Solved it. Again. Ever wonder what each solution cost, Keeper?
I'm not escaping the clock, Keeper. I'm finishing it. Your order built it around me.
Wind it, and I go out. Leave it, and the day does. Choose, Keeper.
Go on, wind it. You were always so good at keeping me.
Delivered, Keeper. Last one. Go on, thank me. Nobody ever has.
